title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is offered a chance at redemption through an impossible mission.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men form a lasting friendship while finding hope and meaning behind prison walls.

title: Interstellar
description: A group of astronauts travel through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family gradually infiltrates the lives of a wealthy household, leading to unexpected consequences.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker discovers that reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against its controllers.

title: Gattaca
description: In a genetically engineered future, a man born without genetic advantages assumes another identity to pursue his dream of space travel.

title: MEN
description: A woman retreats to the English countryside after a tragedy, but finds herself haunted by disturbing encounters with the local men.

title: Midsommar
description: A couple travels to Sweden to visit a rural festival that only occurs once every ninety years, but the celebration quickly turns into a disturbing and violent ritual.

title: RAW
description: A vegetarian veterinary student experiences a disturbing awakening after being forced to eat meat for the first time, revealing her true nature.

title: Drive
description: A Hollywood stunt driver who moonlights as a getaway driver gets involved in a dangerous crime plot that puts his life and the people he cares about at risk.
